description: This file defines a CMake macro 'CreateDepPackage' that automates the creation of a Debian package (DEP package) by setting various CPack variables based on provided arguments. It includes logic for handling optional parameters like name, version, description, maintainer, and dependencies, and enforces that at least one component is specified.

methods.name: CreateDepPackage
methods.description: A macro that creates a Debian package configuration based on specified components and optional metadata, setting CPack variables accordingly.
